reason: node-forge <= 1.4.0: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 verification accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements (forgery needs a low-exponent RSA key). No patched release exists (1.4.0 is the latest, checked 2026-10-02), so no override can fix it. No forge RSA verification ships: cmsVerify.ts checks the RSA signature with WebCrypto, forge only parses and CREATES signatures, and a source guard in tests/signing/rsaVerify.test.ts forbids any .verify( call except WebCrypto's in every code file under src/ (any depth) and in the HTML pages (index.html, public/*.html). verifyAllSignatures has no production caller (multiSign.ts and tests only, kept out of the signing barrel). Developer ruling 2026-10-02. The exemption is void by itself once npm audit reports a fix available (fixAvailable) or after the expiry date; remove the entry then.
